candidate.claim: diff() truncates commitQueue on error but never truncates refQueue, so refs queued by the failed subtree remain and are still applied in commitRoot.
candidate.title: refQueue not rolled back on diff error

verifier.reason: The catch at diff/index.js:368 only resets commitQueue.length with no refQueue rollback in the shown handler, while diff/children.js:119-125 pushes ref triples into the shared refQueue during a subtree diff, and component.js:154 passes that same refQueue to commitRoot after diff returns.

candidate.claim: Component._excess range handle is stored and reused via || without ever being cleared in unmount, so a re-suspend keeps a stale start marker and unmount leaks the reference.
candidate.title: Suspended range handle never cleared

verifier.reason: The excerpt at diff/index.js:417-419 only proves _excess is assigned and reused, with diff/index.js:416 stating this preserves the original range on re-suspend; the cited unmount evidence ends at the opening condition around diff/index.js:811-820 without its body, and no other _excess assignments or clears are shown, so it cannot be settled whether unmount or a successful render clears it or whether the marker is detached on re-suspend. The full unmount function, the successful-render path in diff/index.js, and a repo-wide search for _excess would be needed.
